_comment: Canonical AccountLock document shape. client is the authority - it creates a lock record when an account is locked due to repeated failed authentication attempts. Used for brute-force protection and account lockout enforcement. A field mismatch breaks lockout enforcement and security monitoring.

account_lock._description: Account lock record. Created when failed login attempts exceed the configured threshold. The account is unlocked either by timeout or by admin action.

user_id.description: User ID whose account is locked. Primary key.

failed_attempts.description: Number of consecutive failed login attempts that triggered the lock.

locked_by.description: Admin user ID who manually locked the account, if applicable.

is_locked.description: Whether the account is currently locked.

unlocked_at.description: When the account was unlocked. Null if still locked.

unlocked_by.description: Admin user ID who unlocked the account, if applicable.

locked_at.description: When the account was locked (UTC, ISO 8601 with Z suffix).

expires_at.description: When the lock auto-expires. Null for indefinite locks.
